lines.text: A pump jack isn't pumping from a lake of oil.
The oil is soaked into solid rock, and space is too small to see.
So how do you get oil out of a rock?
You drill down to it, crack the rock open and lift out what seeps through The cracking part is fracking,
and by 2023,
almost two thirds of America's oil came from tight rock like this Imagine you're driving through West Texas.
Has to pump jack, nodding in a field.
Deep under that field is shale.
The rock the oil formed in.
Poours so tiny, the oil can barely move.
First, a rig drills straight down, spinning a string of steel pipe with a bit on the end that grinds through the rock.
ump push heavy mud down the pipe to cool the bit,
carry the crushed rock up and keep the well from blowing out the hole gets lined with steel pipe and cement,
sealing off the groundwater near the surface near the shale, the bit curves and drills sideways along the layer.
Here about two miles on average.
Then a gun goes down the pipe and shoots small holes through the steel and cement into the rock.
That's when the fracking starts Trus pump water and sand down for hours so hard that the rock cracks open around the holes,
it's almost all water and sand up to 16 million gallons for one well.
When the pumps stop, the rock tries to close.
But the sand stuck in the cracks props them open.
And the oil seeps through into the well.
At first, the pressure down there pushes the oil up on its own, when it fades, the pump jack goes on.
A motor turns a crank with heavy counterweights,
the beam rocks and the horsehead lifts a steel rod that runs all the way down the well.
The rod works a pump with two ball valves going up,
the top one closes and lifts the oil while the bottom one opens to let more in, going down,
they swap.
But oil isn't all that comes up, salty water from deep in the rock comes up with it at nearly every well.
Much of it is pumped back underground into disposal wells, and in Oklahoma,
those wells set off most of the recent earthquakes,
the US Geological Sury links only 1 to2% of them to fracking.
So that pumpja was never sucking up a lake,
it's lifting oil out of rock that was cracked open and held open with sand send this to the friend who thinks there's a lake of oil under Texas.

Cut back to the layers

Shows the tight rock as a block

The pores are so tiny the oil barely moves

The bit at the end of the pipe
The bit grinds through the rock
Mud pumps push mud down
Mud cools the bit and carries the cuttings up
And keeps the well from blowing out
The hole is lined with steel and cement to seal off the groundwater

The gun shoots holes
Fracking starts
The site seen from above
Trucks pump water and sand down
The pumping goes on for hours, so hard the rock cracks
Cracks open around the holes
It is almost all water and sand
Up to sixteen million gallons for one well
For one well

Into the grains

Through the propped crack
Into the well

A motor turns a crank with counterweights; the beam rocks
The horse head lifts a steel rod
The rod runs all the way down
The rod works a pump at the bottom
A pump with two ball valves: the top one lifts, the bottom one lets more in, then they swap
But oil is not all that comes up
Salty water comes up from deep in the rock
At nearly every well

Disposal wells
In one state those wells set off most recent earthquakes

So

prompting.structure: 精准主体 + 动作细节 + 场景环境 + 光影色调 + 镜头运镜 + 视觉风格 + 画质 + 约束条件
prompting.language: 中文、英文；台词语言统一，不要中英混用；不要整段贴剧本
prompting.length: 中文 500 字以内，英文 1000 词以内
prompting.multi_shot: 用「镜头 1 / 镜头 2 / 镜头 3」，每个镜头写运镜、动作、地点、声音。不要给镜头写秒数：官方说对精确时间的支持不稳定，硬限时长可能出异常。对话戏适合一镜到底，快动作拆成几段再拼
prompting.references: 先定义再复用：「将图片1中的…定义为主体1」，或简写「张三@图片1」，每个主体带 2–3 个稳定特征；最重要的参考放最前面。模板：「参考图片N中的主体N，生成…」「参考视频N中的动作 / 运镜 / 风格 / 音效，生成…」「参考音频N中的音色，生成…」。即梦全能参考可以写「@图片1 作为首帧，@视频1 参考镜头语言，@音频1 用于配乐」。建议 1–2 张人物图、1 张场景图、1 段运镜视频、1 段音频，不要塞满
prompting.dialogue: 四种符号：音乐（背景中播放着…），音效 <远处传来狗叫声>，台词 {你好，世界}，字幕【第一章：启程】。其他语言写「用日语说道{…}」。指定音色写「使用@音频1…的音色说」，音色会有偏差
prompting.negatives: 没有负面提示词字段，约束写在末尾：「保持无字幕」「避免生成任何文字或字幕」「不要生成Logo」「不要生成水印」。官方承认做不到完全不出字幕，横屏比竖屏出得少
prompting.camera: 直接用标准运镜术语（中景、特写、全景、缓慢推镜、平稳横移、固定镜头）；一个镜头只指定一种运镜
prompting.frame_mode: 要严格保住首尾帧就用首尾帧模式（role=first_frame / last_frame），不能和参考素材同传；写「首帧为图片1」是宽松的替代。编辑或延长视频时直接写「视频N」，不要写「参考视频N」，否则会被当成参考任务
prompting.frames: 人物参考用大头照加全身照，不建议多视图；脸在图里太小会掉脸
pitfalls: 容易出分身 / 双胞胎，末尾加一句全局禁止
多音字、生僻字、形近字会读错
写实参考图会把风格化画面拉回实拍
参考超过 4 个人时稳定性下降
反复续写后人脸会劣化

production_plan.summary: 14 3D render shots → 3 generation units, 3 Seedance 2.0 calls; code render / screen capture 46 shots → 1 code project (10 parts)

review_story.summary: A sourced explainer that corrects a common picture of an industry: the resource is not in an underground lake but locked in rock, then walks through the real steps of getting it out in order, with a s
review_story.hook: 0-6 s: the familiar machine, the misconception drawn as a lake outline under it, then the truth in magnified grains; 6.8 s the question "So how do you get it out of a rock?"; 9-15 s a three-verb previ
highlights: 16-19 s: the scale number with its year, proved by a clipping of the source sentence over a map
20-25 s: "Imagine you are driving through [real place]" puts the viewer in the real location
31-102 s: the procedure in real order, "First, ...", each part labelled and proved by a credited photo or a quoted sentence
102-120 s: the turn: a side effect, with a survey statistic
120-130 s: callback to the opening machine and a share line

camera.setups: virtual documentary camera: slow pans down from the surface into a cut-away, push-ins on parts, pull-outs to maps; feels like one continuous take
camera.gear_guess: motion-graphics / 3D render (Blender or After Effects style), composited with photos and text clippings

lighting.lighting_overall: soft, low-key, top-left light on rendered objects; night and dusk scenes at the surface

grade.grade_overall: desaturated near-neutral greys with a slight cool tint, warm muted earth for soil and rust, one warm amber accent for pressure and flow; photos in black and white

editing.editing: about 27 changes a minute but most are camera moves inside one cut-away; hard cuts to clippings, maps and photos; pops and dings on text and photo appearances

format.format: 9:16 sourced documentary explainer, 130 s, one TTS narrator, no music bed, words at the top, picture in a central band, small print below

style.render_style: sourced documentary cut-away: semi-realistic soft-shaded renders (machines, rock grains, a car interior) and flat cut-away cross-sections of ground layers inside a central picture band (y 27 to 76% of the frame), with real black-and-white photos pinned in paper frames and paper clippings of source sentences
style.outline: no outlines; hair-line darker edges where surfaces meet; thin white leader lines from labels
style.shading: soft gradients from top-left light on rendered objects; strata as banded greys with fine horizontal streaks; glossy highlights on liquids
style.shape_language: horizontal layers, thin straight pipes and curves, angular mineral grains, rounded machine housings
style.texture: fine horizontal streaks in rock layers, speckle for granular rock, faint grid on the black top and bottom bands
style.type_ui: top caption: words appear one at a time, said words grey, newest white bold, one keyword in a blue text-selection box with two round handles; uppercase bold small-caps labels with leader lines; big white numbers with small units; serif text on paper clippings with an underline; small grey print for credits, sources and honesty notes (Cut-away view, illustration; Time compressed; Not to scale)
